# @three-ws/voice

> Speech for avatars, ASR (speech→text), TTS (text→speech), and Audio2Face-3D lipsync visemes in one import. The voice layer for three.ws avatars.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/voice/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and API
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/voice/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an AI agent should use and modify this repo
- [Site](https://nirholas.github.io/voice/): rendered docs
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/voice)

- [three.ws](https://three.ws): the platform this package belongs to
